fluff.overview: The CCAF fields conventional infantry in larger numbers than its limited industrial base might suggest, drawing on the Confederation's deep tradition of citizens' militia service. Capellan soldiers learn to fight with fewer resources and less support than their counterparts in wealthier states, compensating with resourcefulness and ideological commitment. Jump-capable infantry give CCAF commanders a vertical mobility option for urban combat and rough terrain operations. The added cost of jump equipment limits their numbers compared to foot formations, but their ability to bypass obstacles and reach elevated positions makes them valuable in the defensive fighting the Confederation often faces. Heavy weapons sections carry man-portable long-range missile launchers that extend the platoon's engagement envelope far beyond normal infantry ranges, providing organic indirect fire capability at the squad level.
